sql: with lp as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, captured_at, side, quantity, realized_pnl from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select market_ticker, side, quantity, realized_pnl, to_char(captured_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as captured from lp where market_ticker in ('KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26-6.8','KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26-7.0','KXBIGGESTQUAKE-21SEP26-6.4','KXRT-RES-94','KXRT-RES-93','KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26SEP18-E39.4','KXUSLEI-26SEP18-T0.2') order by market_ticker
